scripts.dev-backend: dotenv -- sh -c 'export API_PORT=${API_PORT:-3000}; cd backend_elixir && mix run --no-halt'
scripts.dev-client-no-refresh: VITE_DISABLE_AUTO_REFRESH=true CASCADE_DISABLE_AUTO_REFRESH=true dotenv -- npm --workspace=client run dev
scripts.dev: concurrently "npm run dev-backend" "npm run dev-client" "npm run sub:electron"
scripts.dev-no-refresh: concurrently "npm run dev-backend" "npm run dev-client-no-refresh" "npm run sub:electron"
scripts.dev-client-staging: dotenv -e client/.env.staging -- npm --workspace=client run dev -- --mode staging
scripts.build:vps: npm run build && npm run build:client
scripts.start:vps: dotenv -- sh -c 'export API_PORT=${API_PORT:-3000}; cd backend_elixir && mix run --no-halt'
scripts.test:elixir:deploy-safety: npm run test:elixir:certified-image && npm run test:elixir:rollback && npm run test:elixir:edge
scripts.test:elixir-release:full: npm run test:elixir-release && npm run test:elixir:unit-parity && npm run test:chat-mission && npm run test:desktop-runner
scripts.test:release:backend:full: npm run build && npm run test:elixir-release:full && npm run test:cli-agents
scripts.package: npm run build && npm run build:desktop-runtime && npm --prefix cascade-electron run package
scripts.make: npm run build && npm run build:desktop-runtime && npm --prefix cascade-electron run make
scripts.build:client:android: CAPACITOR=true dotenv -e client/android.env -- npm --workspace=client run build
scripts.android:build: npm run build:client:android && node scripts/prepare-capacitor-assets.mjs && npm run cap:sync
scripts.android:apk: npm run android:codex-runtime && npm run android:build && cd android && JAVA_HOME="${JAVA_HOME:-$HOME/.local/jdks/jdk-21.0.11+10}" ./gradlew clean assembleDebug && cp -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../client/public/cascade-android.apk && cp -f app/build/outputs/apk/debug/app-debug.apk ../client/dist/cascade-android.apk
